name: Craft CMS
description: Craft CMS is a flexible self-hosted content management system for custom websites and digital experiences. It supports entries, sections, custom fields, assets, categories, tags, users, multisite content, drafts, revisions, plugins, project configuration, and a core GraphQL API.
agentUseSummary: Relay sends one fixed core GraphQL query for a preselected entry UUID and returns only that UUID, status, and creation and update timestamps. Craft schemas can expose content and mutations, so Relay requires a dedicated private schema token with entry-query access only to the selected section and no mutation permissions, then discards every non-lifecycle field before returning data.

capabilities.label: Read selected entry lifecycle
capabilities.description: Read one selected entry's UUID, status, and lifecycle timestamps.

allowed.label: Read selected entry lifecycle
allowed.description: Use one fixed core GraphQL query for one selected entry UUID and return only its lifecycle projection.

blocked.label: Expose content or private project data
blocked.description: Titles, slugs, URIs, authors, post dates, expiry dates, custom fields, relations, assets, drafts, revisions, and every non-lifecycle field are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Mutate Craft CMS
blocked.description: Entries, drafts, revisions, assets, categories, tags, users, globals, project configuration, plugins, and every GraphQL mutation or other write are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Craft CMS access
blocked.description: Entry collections, other entry UUIDs, other sections, assets, categories, tags, users, global sets, arbitrary GraphQL documents, introspection, aliases, directives, batching, redirects, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Entry Lifecycle Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected entry's lifecycle projection; content, identities, other resources, administration, and mutations remain blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized public HTTPS Craft CMS staging project must provide a dedicated private GraphQL schema token whose schema permits entry queries only for the selected entry's section, permits no mutations, and is not the control-panel Full Schema, plus one selected entry UUID and Fairfax validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console lane, configure the least-privilege private schema and token, enter the project URL and selected entry UUID through Relay, then validate exact-entry binding, fixed-query enforcement, content-field redaction, GraphQL error denial, redirect and private-DNS denial, mutation denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Official Craft documentation defines the built-in /actions/graphql/api endpoint, public and private schemas, bearer tokens, JSON POST requests with variables, entry queries filtered by UUID, lifecycle fields, and schema-controlled mutations.
Official element documentation defines UUID, status, dateCreated, and dateUpdated as native element lifecycle properties, supporting Relay's narrow response projection.
Official Craft CMS documentation identifies Craft as a self-hosted PHP CMS whose headless applications access content through GraphQL.
